configuration.data:
kind: AdaptiveDialog
beginDialog:
  kind: OnEventActivity
  id: main
  eventName: Microsoft.PowerApps.Copilot.SetModelPageContext
  actions:
    - kind: ParseValue
      id: QEQNIF
      variable: Global.PA__Copilot_Model_PageContext_Version
      valueType: String
      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelPageContext_Version), Text(System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelPageContext_Version), "-1")

    - kind: ParseValue
      id: r6ZsTS
      variable: Topic.PageInput
      valueType:
        kind: Record
        properties:
          pageInput:
            type:
              kind: Record
              properties:
                entityTypeName: String
                id:
                  type:
                    kind: Record
                    properties:
                      guid: String

                pageName: String
                pageType: String
                queryStringParameters: String
                viewId:
                  type:
                    kind: Record
                    properties:
                      guid: String

                viewType: Number

      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelPageContext), System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelPageContext, System.Activity.Value)

    - kind: ParseValue
      id: t4YsPS
      variable: Topic.PageContext
      valueType:
        kind: Record
        properties:
          pageContext:
            type:
              kind: Record
              properties:
                entityTypeName: String
                id:
                  type:
                    kind: Record
                    properties:
                      guid: String

                pageName: String
                pageType: String
                viewId:
                  type:
                    kind: Record
                    properties:
                      guid: String

                viewType: Number

      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelPageContext), System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelPageContext, System.Activity.Value)

    - kind: SetVariable
      id: setVariable_a3F2Es
      variable: Global.PA__Copilot_Model_PageContext
      value: =If(!IsBlank(Topic.PageInput.pageInput),{'pageContext':Topic.PageInput.pageInput}, Topic.PageContext)
configuration.description: Triggered on Event received  (Microsoft.PowerApps.Copilot.SetModelPageContext) to process the Page Context
configuration.name: Model App Page Context - Event Trigger
